definitions.gloss: household account book; household budget book
definitions.explanation: A notebook or record used to track household income and expenses, traditionally kept by the person managing family finances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{家計簿|かけいぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To keep a household account book every day.

examples.japanese: {家計簿|かけいぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started keeping a budget book, my wasteful spending has decreased.

examples.english: It's convenient to manage your household budget with a smartphone app.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧ (household finances) and {簿|ぼ} (ledger/register). The practice of keeping a {家計簿|かけいぼ} is deeply rooted in Japanese household culture. The concept has also gained international attention under the name "kakeibo" as a budgeting method.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a household account book
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: budget tracking app
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review one's household budget
